{{Quote|Escaped from Jabba's palace after attempting to poison Jabba's chuba stew, killing his loyal chef instead.|The bounty posting on Romi Moola|<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
'''Chuba stew''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] eaten by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was available during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Stew/Legends|stew]] was made from the<ref name="BHG" /> non-sentient [[Gorg/Legends|gorg]] species, which was named chuba in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|creature|gorg|gorg}}</ref> The Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] ate chuba stew and had it prepared by a [[Unidentified chef (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)|chef]] loyal to him. However,<ref name="BHG" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', in which the [[Unidentified chef (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)|chef's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] is mentioned, to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on Jabba by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Romi Moola]]. Moola [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] a chuba stew being prepared by the chef in the hope that Jabba would consume it. Instead, the chef tried some first and died in Jabba's place, which led to Jabba placing a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Moola's head.<ref name="BHG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chuba stew was first mentioned in Romi Moola's bounty posting in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] strategy guide ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', which was written by [[David Hodgson]] and published by [[Prima Games]] in [[2002]].<ref name="BHG" />
